verdict.rationale: Evidence covers deposit frequency, billing profiles, and payin/payment processing mechanics, but there is no mention of where in-flight or held funds are held, whether balances earn yield, or how platform funds are segregated from Rainforest's own accounts (e.g., FBO account structure, safeguarding). Missing for 10: fund segregation/FBO account disclosure, yield/interest treatment on held balances, and custody/holding location details for in-flight funds.
